notes.title: Halloween update
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

I just updated Mystwood Manor with some bonus  Halloween outfits for all staff members.
I have also added one new (unlockable) guest.

Thank you all very much for the great support so far!

Enjoy the update and Happy Halloween!
Faerin

notes.title: Mystwood Manor update v1.0.3
notes.notes:
Hey guys,

I fixed a bug causing the "Time to talk" event not to trigger for some players.
As well as some minor typos and bugs.

Thanks a lot for all the positive feedback so far, I hope you will continue to enjoy the game!

All the best,
Faerin

notes.title: Mystwood Manor release date announcement!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

I'v been making great progress on my upcoming game Mystwood Manor, and I'm still on track for the September release!

I'm pleased to announce that the planned release date on Steam is: September 30th!

Please make sure to add it to your wishlist if you haven't already, as this really helps me to generate more exposure.

In the mean time, here are some new teaser images for you guys:
